meta.title: Marsa Al Saadiyat Abu Dhabi | Waterfront Residences
meta.description: Register your interest in Marsa Al Saadiyat by Aldar on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi. Explore private mansions, luxury villas, waterfront apartments and branded residences.

hero.eyebrow: NEWLY ANNOUNCED · SAADIYAT ISLAND, ABU DHABI
hero.body: A landmark AED 100 billion waterfront destination on Saadiyat Island — a 6.4 million sqm masterplan of private mansions, luxury villas, waterfront apartments and branded residences along an 8km waterfront with Abu Dhabi's largest marina.

vision.title: The Next Chapter Of Saadiyat Island's Evolution
vision.body: An integrated destination across approximately 6.4 million square metres, weaving mansions, villas, apartments and branded residences alongside beaches, marina facilities, a theatre district, schools and healthcare into one walkable waterfront community for more than 58,000 residents.

lifestyle.title: A Destination Built Around The Water
lifestyle.body: From beaches and promenade dining to marina living and luxury hospitality, Marsa Al Saadiyat is designed as a continuous waterfront experience — a one-kilometre promenade lined with retail and dining connects the beaches to the marina and yacht club.

cards.title: Beaches & promenade
cards.body: Approximately 5.6km of beaches and a 1km waterfront promenade

cards.title: Marina living
cards.body: Abu Dhabi's largest marina with a dedicated yacht club

cards.title: Luxury hospitality
cards.body: Two luxury hotels anchoring the wider hospitality offering

cards.title: Cultural district
cards.body: Saadiyat's museums and theatre district minutes away

masterplan.title: An Integrated, Walkable Waterfront Community
masterplan.body: Select a numbered point on the illustrative masterplan to explore each planned zone. Final layout is subject to official confirmation.

hotspots.title: Marina & Yacht Club
hotspots.body: Abu Dhabi's largest marina with a dedicated yacht club.

hotspots.title: Residential Neighbourhoods
hotspots.body: Private mansions, luxury villas, waterfront apartments and branded residences.

hotspots.title: Theatre District
hotspots.body: A dedicated cultural and performance district minutes from the coast.

hotspots.title: Beachfront & Promenade
hotspots.body: 5.6km of beaches connected by a one-kilometre waterfront promenade.

hotspots.title: Landscaped Central Park
hotspots.body: A landscaped central park woven through the residential neighbourhoods.

hotspots.title: Schools & Healthcare
hotspots.body: Community schools and healthcare facilities within walking distance.

residences.title: Four Ways To Call The Waterfront Home
residences.body: Private mansions, luxury villas, waterfront apartments and branded residences. Layouts, sizes and pricing have not yet been released. Illustrative imagery.

invest.eyebrow: WHY INVEST IN MARSA AL SAADIYAT
invest.title: A Landmark Scale, In A Location That Cannot Be Replicated
invest.body: Marsa Al Saadiyat combines a landmark development track record with one of Abu Dhabi's most limited waterfront settings.

cards.title: Landmark AED 100 Billion Scale
cards.body: One of Abu Dhabi's most significant waterfront and mixed-use developments announced to date.

cards.title: Prime Saadiyat Island Waterfront
cards.body: Positioned alongside Saadiyat's established cultural and residential district.

cards.title: Experienced Master Developer
cards.body: Delivered by an established, listed real estate developer.

cards.title: Limited Waterfront Land
cards.body: An 8km waterfront setting on an island with finite coastal frontage.

cards.title: Diverse Residential Offering
cards.body: Mansions, villas, apartments and branded residences within one destination.

cards.title: Marina, Hospitality & Retail
cards.body: Abu Dhabi's largest marina, two luxury hotels and a waterfront promenade.

cards.title: Future Transport Connectivity
cards.body: A planned underground Etihad Rail station and new road, tunnel and bridge links.

cards.title: Abu Dhabi's Long-Term Growth
cards.body: Positioned to appeal to both local and international buyers over the long term.

connectivity.title: Anchored On Saadiyat Island, Connected To All Of Abu Dhabi
connectivity.body: A planned underground Etihad Rail high-speed station, plus new road, tunnel and bridge connections toward Reem Island and Umm Yifeenah Island, place the destination within reach of the wider UAE.

timeline.title: Where Marsa Al Saadiyat Stands Today
timeline.body: All dates below are expected and planned, subject to official confirmation.

phases.title: Announced — 2026
phases.body: Project launch witnessed with an investment value of AED 100 billion.

phases.title: Priority Registration — Open Now
phases.body: Register interest to receive project updates ahead of public launch.

phases.title: First Residential Sales — Expected H2 2026
phases.body: First residential sales expected to launch.

phases.title: Future Phases — To Be Announced
phases.body: Further residential phases and details subject to future announcement.

amenities.title: Coastal Wellness, Built Into Everyday Life
amenities.body: Marsa Al Saadiyat is planned around movement, nature and walkable access to daily amenities.

registerForm.title: Join The Priority Registration List
registerForm.body: Register today to receive project information, priority updates and early notice ahead of the first residential sales launch expected in the second half of 2026. No obligation, no cost.

finalCta.title: Ready To Register?
finalCta.body: Share a few details and a dedicated property consultant will be in touch with project information and priority updates.
